name: legacy-modernization
description: [Limited availability] Modernize legacy applications onto OutSystems on a live ODC tenant: extract the requirements from legacy sources (/extract-requirements), design the replacement app (/generate-design-options), build and verify it (/workflow-legacy-app), the migration close-out documents, the test evidence pack, a toolkit overview (/how-it-works), and the planner, designer, developer, reviewer, tester and reporter roles. Uses the outsystems plugin's MCP server and its Mentor build skills.
